v.s: Zhask summons a (Nightmaric Spawn) that gains 50% of his Attributes plus an additional 20 (Magic Power). (Nightmaric Spawn) will automatically attack nearby enemies, each attack dealing 120 (+(120% Magic Power)) (Magic Damage). After every 3 attacks, it fires a (Death Ray) at the target, dealing 90 (+(15% Magic Power)) (Magic Damage) and slowing them by up to 60% for 0.6s. If Zhask is too far away from (Nightmaric Spawn), it will disappear.\n(Death Ray) is considered a Basic Attack but cannot Crit.\n(Fusion Enhanced): The damage of (Nightmaric Spawn) is increased to 200%, and it can be repositioned.

Every 2 basic attacks of the Spawn will fire a death ray at the enemy. If the death ray strikes the target 7 times consecutively, then it will cause a stun effect. This is definitely Zhask's core skill, we recommend that you keep your Spawn close to you during combat, not only does this little fellow bring damage but he can also provide some extra crowd control. Also, enemies may gain quite a bit of gold slaying the Spawn, as a Planes Dominator you should always look out for the welfare of your minions.

Zhask fires a penetrating psychic beam in the designated direction, dealing 300( +100% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies along the way. (Nightmaric Spawn) will also cast (Mind Eater) at the same location. If an enemy is hit by both beams, they will be stunned for 0.5s.\n(Fusion Enhanced): The damage of Zhask and (Nightmaric Spawn) is fused together, dealing 540( +180% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage).
As the damage does not diminish upon impact, use this ability in conjunction with a well position Nightmaric Spawn to really leave a mark on your enemies!

Zhask releases a swarm of (Hive Clones) in the targeted direction. The clones will explode and deal 110( +35% Total Magic Power) (Magic Damage) to enemies on contact, reducing their Movement Speed by 80% for 1s. 
If (Hive Clones) find no target, they will burrow into the ground and ambush enemies passing by.
(Fusion Enhanced): Zhask releases several swarms of (Hive Clones).
Subsequent damage dealt to the same target decays to 20%.

This is a very tactical skill, use it during laning to whoever is attacking your Nightmaric Spawn, not only providing large amounts of damage but also at the same time protecting your Spawn. Placing traps in certain areas of the map will also cause some mental pressure for the enemy team.
Upon death, Zhask summons a frenzied (Nightmaric Spawn) on the spot, which gradually loses HP over time until death.

Using this ultimate in critical moments will allow your Spawn to deal legendary amounts of damage, as no hero can match the power of a full form Nightmaric Spawn. However, the crack in the planescape can only be sustained for 10 seconds, so use your time wisely.
Unique Passive - Affliction: Basic Attacks deal extra Magic Damage equal to 50 plus 30% of the hero's Magic Power.
Unique Passive - Mysticism: Getting a kill or assist on an enemy Minion will restore 4% Mana. (An assist occurs when a Minion dies within 2s after taking damage from the hero.)
Unique Passive - Mystery: Gains 21%-35% extra Magic Power (scales with level).
Unique Passive - Timestream: Hero kills or assists reduce the Ultimate's current cooldown by 30%.
Unique Passive - Spellbreaker: When attacking an enemy, gains 0.1% extra Magic Penetration for each point of the enemy's Magic Defense, capped at 20%.
Unique Passive - Guard: Gains a shield equal to 200% of Magic Power. The shield will regenerate 20s after being damaged, and grants 30 Movement Speed while it lasts.
